title: Expiring Professional Liability Cover and the Repayment Plan Down Payment (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, a provider's professional liability policy on file must stay in force. When that policy is close to expiring, a repayment plan down payment on the agreement is raised.

**Clause.** The down payment liability-cover points are set by the days from today to the expiration of the professional liability policy on file:

| Days from today to the expiration date | Percentage points added to the down payment percentage |
|---|---|
| 90 or fewer | 10 |
| More than 90 and at most 180 | 5 |
| More than 180 | Nothing |

The down payment percentage is the percentage at which the down payment base is taken.

## Terms

- **Expiration date.** The liability policy expiration date recorded on the agreement.
- **Counting.** Days are calendar days from today to that date. Today is not counted; the expiration date is. An expiration date already past is fewer than 90 days away.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Policy expires 90 days from today: 10 points. 91 days: 5 points.
- 180 days: 5 points. 181 days: nothing.
